Seek out the headmaster for a secondary profession.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
}}
* No secondary profession
* Primary profession not a [[Necromancer]]

===Objectives===
* Speak with [[Headmaster Kuju]] in the [[Shing Jea Monastery|monastery]].

===Reward===
* 50 [[Experience]]

==Walkthrough==
Go to southeastern [[Shing Jea Monastery]]. The headmasters are gathered in one place.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Master Togo
''If you are interested in taking the Necromancer profession as your secondary field of study, then you will need to speak with [[Headmaster Kuju]]. I think you will find her quite pleasant for a Necromancer, and she can certainly teach you all you need to know. Seek her out in the [[Shing Jea Monastery]].''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = Yes, Master
| decline = I'm not sure about this.
| ask = If you wish to become a Necromancer, find [[Headmaster Kuju]] in the [[Shing Jea Monastery|monastery]]. In any case, you must leave me to my work now.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Headmaster Kuju
:''Well hello there, youngster! Of course I can teach you! It will be my great pleasure to welcome another young Necromancer into the fold. And I cannot wait to introduce you to my grandchildren!''

:''Are you ready to learn the dark magics of Death, Blood, and Curses? Consider your choice carefully.''
